_comment: Declarative arch → builder runner mapping. Consumed by 1_workflows/src/scripts/cloud-ship-container-step-build-docker.sh and cloud-ship-ci-builder-dispatch.sh. amd64 = local GHA/host. arm64 = remote ssh runner on oci-apps (cloud-builder-x-deb-nixhm image — published from ~/git/unix/cb_containers-builders/build.json [.images.cloud-builder-x-deb-nixhm.ghcr]). Probe retry/backoff lets the engine survive transient SSH timeouts (WG flap, sshd MaxStartups burst) instead of aborting the whole pipeline on a single failed connection.

dispatch._comment: Async build dispatch: engine writes the docker-run command to a remote script, launches it via nohup (detached from the SSH session), and polls a status file. Survives WG flaps / sshd restarts during long builds — the build keeps running on the runner; the engine just reconnects to read status.
